name: Vidar Open 2011
information: The cost of registration is $3n+1, where n is the number of events you will be competing in. Participants in the Footsolving round will be charged an additional $7 to cover equipment value depreciation and other miscellaneous issues. For those of you doing math, this means that we charge $3 for every event except footsolving, and $10 for footsolving. $1 from each registration is charged as the WCA fee, and goes towards maintenance of the WCA database and other miscellaneous items.
